info.title: Estimate
info.description:
Estimate shipment API


## Authentication


This API requires **Bearer Token** authentication. Include your token in the
`Authorization` header:


```

Authorization: Bearer <your-token>

```


All endpoints also require an `x-api-key` header.

post.description: Obtain a quick or full estimate for a shipment

requestBody.description: Provide all the information needed to obtain an estimate.

200.description: Successful estimate comprising of outbound and return shipment estimates

400.description: An error based on user input occurred.

bearerAuth.description:
For secure access, this API uses Bearer Authentication (also known as token authentication). 
You must send a Bearer token in the Authorization header when making requests to protected 
endpoints. The token should be prefixed with the word "Bearer" followed by a space. 
Example: "Authorization: Bearer <YourTokenHere>".
